_doc: Themes with EVIDENCE of converting, plus the explore/exploit split used when choosing what to pin. This is data, not code, so a new winner can be added without a deploy. Keep 'evidence' honest: a theme earns a place here because sales data put it there, not because it feels right.
_explore_doc: Share of each batch reserved for products that are NOT in a proven theme - newest-discovered first. Exploiting a known winner compounds; only exploring finds the next one. 0.35 keeps roughly two-thirds on what we know sells while still testing ~4 new products a day. Raise it if the proven themes go stale, lower it if a theme is clearly running hot.
